name: Hamsafar Daily Check-In (PKT 9 AM)

nodes.name: Daily 9 AM PKT Cron
nodes.notes: Fires at 04:00 UTC = 09:00 PKT (UTC+5). Adjust if your n8n server is in a different timezone.

nodes.name: Fetch Active Session IDs (WhatsApp Users)
nodes.notes: Calls a protected endpoint that returns a list of phone-number session IDs for consented users who have been active in the last 7 days. See backend setup instructions.

_env_vars_required.HAMSAFAR_INTERNAL_API_KEY: A secret key to protect the /api/active-sessions endpoint

_backend_endpoint_required.description: Must return a list of {session_id, phone_number} for all WhatsApp sessions (those with session_id starting with 'wp_') where consent.memory=true and last activity was within 7 days.
